about.founders: Evelin and Giovanni, husband and wife and co-founders.
about.evelin: Evelin inspired the idea of Christian Devotionals, has designed and tested several features of the app, and has financially carried most of the ministry.
about.giovanni: Giovanni is the developer who builds it every day, creating content to be taken to the nations.
about.closing: Without both of us, this ministry would not exist. Without ads there is no income to cover the costs: your gift helps it not depend on our family alone.
